api_types.name: ControllerHealth

fields.name: HealthProbeBindAddress
fields.doc: healthProbeBindAddress is the TCP address that the controller should bind to for serving health probes It can be set to "0" or "" to disable serving the health probe. Defaults to ":8081".

fields.name: ReadinessEndpointName
fields.doc: readinessEndpointName is the name for the readiness endpoint. Defaults to "readyz".

fields.name: LivenessEndpointName

api_types.name: ControllerConfigurationSpec
api_types.doc: ControllerConfigurationSpec defines the global configuration for controllers registered with the manager.

fields.name: GroupKindConcurrency
fields.doc: groupKindConcurrency is a map from a Kind to the number of concurrent reconciliation allowed for that controller. When a controller is registered within this manager using the builder utilities, users have to specify the type the controller reconciles in the For(...) call. If the object's kind passed matches one of the keys in this map, the concurrency for that controller is set to the number specified. The key is expected to be consistent in form with GroupKind.String(), e.g. TrainJob.trainer.kubeflow.org. Defaults to empty map, which means no limits.

api_types.name: CertManagement
api_types.doc: CertManagement holds configuration related to webhook server certificate generation.

fields.name: Enable
fields.doc: enable controls whether the cert management is enabled. If disabled, certificates must be provided externally. Defaults to true.

fields.name: WebhookServiceName
fields.doc: webhookServiceName is the name of the Service used as part of the DNSName when generating the webhook server certificate. Defaults to "kubeflow-trainer-controller-manager".

fields.name: WebhookSecretName
fields.doc: webhookSecretName is the name of the Secret used to store the CA and server certificates. Defaults to "kubeflow-trainer-webhook-cert".

api_types.name: ClientConnection
api_types.doc: ClientConnection provides additional configuration options for Kubernetes API server client.

fields.name: QPS
fields.doc: qps controls the number of queries per second allowed before client-side throttling connection to the API server. Defaults to 50.

fields.name: Burst
fields.doc: burst allows extra queries to accumulate when a client is not using its full QPS allocation. Defaults to 100.

fields.name: Port
fields.doc: port is the port that the status server serves at. Defaults to 10443.

fields.name: QPS
fields.doc: qps controls the number of queries per second allowed for the status server's Kubernetes client before client-side throttling. Defaults to 5.

fields.name: Burst
fields.doc: burst allows extra queries to accumulate when the status server client is not using its full QPS allocation. Defaults to 10.

api_types.name: TLSOptions

fields.name: MinVersion

fields.name: CipherSuites

fields.name: NextProtos
fields.doc: nextProtos is the list of application-level protocols negotiated during the TLS handshake. Set to ["h2", "http/1.1"] to enable HTTP/2, or omit to disable it (mitigates CVE-2023-44487 and CVE-2023-39325). +listType=atomic

fields.name: MPI

api_types.name: TorchMLPolicySource
api_types.doc: TorchMLPolicySource represents a PyTorch runtime configuration.

fields.name: EnvInjection
fields.doc: envInjection configures which additional containers should receive the PET_* environment variables. By default, the PET_* variables are injected only into the main "node" container. Use this field to also inject them into selected sidecar or init containers. For torchtune, envInjection targets still receive PET_MASTER_ADDR and PET_MASTER_PORT even though the main trainer container uses command-line rendezvous instead. Defaults to empty (main container only).

api_types.name: EnvInjection
api_types.doc: EnvInjection specifies which containers in which jobs receive framework env injection. Defined as a standalone type so it can be embedded by other MLPolicySource variants in the future.

fields.name: Targets
fields.doc: targets defines which replicated job containers receive PET_* env injection. The item limit keeps runtime validation bounded while allowing common multi-job runtimes to target their auxiliary containers. +listType=map +listMapKey=jobName

api_types.name: EnvInjectionTarget
api_types.doc: EnvInjectionTarget specifies a replicated job and the containers within it that should receive PET_* env injection.

fields.name: JobName
fields.doc: jobName is the name of the target replicated job (e.g. "node"). Using "jobName" rather than "replicatedJobName" keeps the API future-proof for other CRD types (LWS, Grove, Slurm, etc.).

fields.name: ContainerNames
fields.doc: containerNames lists the container names within the target job that should receive PET_* envs. The item limit keeps admission checks small while covering typical preflight and sidecar use cases. +listType=set
markers: +kubebuilder:validation:XValidation:rule="!self.exists(c, c == 'node')", message="containerNames must not include the main node container because PET_* envs are always injected into it"

fields.name: Initializer

fields.name: Trainer
fields.doc: trainer defines the configuration of the trainer. The field is immutable.

fields.name: RuntimePatches
fields.doc: runtimePatches defines custom patches applied to the TrainJob's Runtime. Patches are keyed by manager to provide clear ownership and avoid conflicts between controllers. +listType=map +listMapKey=manager

fields.name: Suspend
fields.doc: suspend defines whether to suspend the running TrainJob.

fields.name: ActiveDeadlineSeconds
fields.doc: activeDeadlineSeconds specifies the duration in seconds relative to the TrainJob start time (which resets on resume from suspension) that the TrainJob may be active before the system tries to terminate it. Value must be a positive integer. Once reached, all running Pods are terminated and the TrainJob status becomes Failed with reason: DeadlineExceeded.

fields.name: ManagedBy
fields.doc: managedBy is used to indicate the controller or entity that manages a TrainJob. The value must be either an empty, `trainer.kubeflow.org/trainjob-controller` or `kueue.x-k8s.io/multikueue`. The built-in TrainJob controller reconciles TrainJob which don't have this field at all or the field value is the reserved string `trainer.kubeflow.org/trainjob-controller`, but delegates reconciling TrainJobs with a 'kueue.x-k8s.io/multikueue' to the Kueue. The field is immutable.
markers: +kubebuilder:validation:XValidation:rule="self in ['trainer.kubeflow.org/trainjob-controller', 'kueue.x-k8s.io/multikueue']", message="ManagedBy must be trainer.kubeflow.org/trainjob-controller or kueue.x-k8s.io/multikueue if set"

api_types.name: RuntimeRef

api_types.name: Initializer
api_types.doc: Initializer represents the desired configuration for the dataset and model initialization. It is used to initialize the assets (dataset and pre-trained model) and pre-process data.

api_types.name: DatasetInitializer
api_types.doc: DatasetInitializer represents the desired configuration to initialize and pre-process dataset. The DatasetInitializer spec will override the runtime Job template which contains this label: `trainer.kubeflow.org/trainjob-ancestor-step: dataset-initializer`

fields.doc: storageUri is the URI for the dataset provider. If set, it may be empty, or it must be a valid URI format (e.g., s3://bucket/path, gs://bucket/path).
markers: +kubebuilder:validation:XValidation:rule="self == '' || self.matches('^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9+.-]*://.+$')",message="storageUri may be empty, or it must be a valid URI (scheme://...)"

fields.doc: env is the list of environment variables to set in the dataset initializer container. These values will be merged with the TrainingRuntime's dataset initializer environments. +listType=map +listMapKey=name

fields.name: SecretRef
fields.doc: secretRef is the reference to the secret with credentials to download dataset. Secret must be created in the TrainJob's namespace.

api_types.name: ModelInitializer
api_types.doc: ModelInitializer represents the desired configuration to initialize pre-trained model. The ModelInitializer spec will override the runtime Job template which contains this label: `trainer.kubeflow.org/trainjob-ancestor-step: dataset-initializer`

fields.name: StorageUri
fields.doc: storageUri is the URI for the model provider. If set, it may be empty, or it must be a valid URI format (e.g., s3://bucket/path, gs://bucket/path).
markers: +kubebuilder:validation:XValidation:rule="self == '' || self.matches('^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9+.-]*://.+$')",message="storageUri may be empty, or it must be a valid URI (scheme://...)"

fields.name: Env

fields.name: SecretRef

api_types.name: Trainer

fields.name: Image
fields.doc: image is the container image for the training container.

fields.name: Command
fields.doc: command for the entrypoint of the training container. +listType=atomic

fields.name: Args
fields.doc: args for the entrypoint for the training container. +listType=atomic

fields.name: Env
fields.doc: env is the list of environment variables to set in the training container. These values will be merged with the TrainingRuntime's trainer environments. +listType=map +listMapKey=name

fields.name: NumNodes
fields.doc: numNodes is the number of training nodes. TODO (andreyvelich): Do we want to support dynamic num of nodes in TrainJob for PyTorch elastic: `--nnodes=1:4` ?

fields.name: ResourcesPerNode
fields.doc: resourcesPerNode defines the compute resources for each training node.

fields.name: NumProcPerNode
fields.doc: numProcPerNode is the number of processes/workers/slots on every training node. For the MPI runtime only int value can be set to represent number of slots per node. For the Torch runtime the value defaults to `auto` and can be overridden with an int.

fields.doc: trainerStatus contains the latest observed runtime status of the Trainer step of the TrainJob. It reflects progress, remaining time, metrics, and the last update timestamp. fields.name: Succeeded

fields.name: Failed
fields.doc: failed is the number of failed child Jobs.

fields.name: Active
fields.doc: active is the number of child Jobs with at least 1 pod in a running or pending state which are not marked for deletion.

fields.name: Suspended
fields.doc: suspended is the number of child Jobs which are in a suspended state.

api_types.name: TrainerStatus

fields.name: ProgressPercentage

fields.name: EstimatedRemainingSeconds
fields.doc: estimatedRemainingSeconds gives the estimated remaining training time in seconds before the train job is completed. The value will be empty if it is unknown.

fields.name: Metrics

fields.name: LastUpdatedTime

operator_config.name: AddToScheme
operator_config.doc:
AddToScheme adds all types of this clientset into the given scheme. This allows composition
of clientsets, like in:

	import (
	  "k8s.io/client-go/kubernetes"
	  clientsetscheme "k8s.io/client-go/kubernetes/scheme"
	  aggregatorclientsetscheme "k8s.io/kube-aggregator/pkg/client/clientset_generated/clientset/scheme"
	)

	kclientset, _ := kubernetes.NewForConfig(c)
	_ = aggregatorclientsetscheme.AddToScheme(clientsetscheme.Scheme)

After this, RawExtensions in Kubernetes types will serialize kube-aggregator types
correctly.

defaultFeatureGates consists of all known Trainer-specific feature keys.

operator_config.name: AnnotationMetricsPollInterval
operator_config.doc:
AnnotationMetricsPollInterval specifies how often to poll metrics (supports duration format).
Accepts: "30s", "1m", or integer seconds "30" (min: 5s, max: 300s)
Default: 30s
Example: trainer.opendatahub.io/metrics-poll-interval: "45s"

operator_config.name: AnnotationMetricsPort
operator_config.doc:
AnnotationMetricsPort specifies the port where the training pod exposes metrics.
Default: 28080. Valid range: 1024-65535 (non-privileged ports).
Ports 0-1023 require root privileges and are incompatible with OpenShift
restricted SCCs and Kubernetes non-root security policies.
Example: trainer.opendatahub.io/metrics-port: "8080"

operator_config.name: AnnotationProgressionTracking
operator_config.doc:
AnnotationProgressionTracking enables/disables progression tracking for a TrainJob.
Value: "true" to enable tracking, any other value or absence disables it.
Example: trainer.opendatahub.io/progression-tracking: "true"

operator_config.name: AnnotationTrainerStatus
operator_config.doc:
AnnotationTrainerStatus stores the JSON-encoded training status/progress.
This annotation is automatically updated by the controller with real-time metrics.
Example: trainer.opendatahub.io/trainerStatus: '{"status":"training","progress":{"percent":45.2},...}'

operator_config.name: jsonSanitizer
operator_config.doc:
sanitizeJSON replaces NaN and Infinity values with null in JSON strings.
Python's json.dumps() allows these by default, but they are not valid JSON,
causing Go's json.Unmarshal to fail.
jsonSanitizer matches quoted strings (to skip them) or bare NaN/Infinity tokens (to replace).
By matching strings first, NaN/Infinity inside string values are preserved unchanged.
